segments.name: Pipeline
segments.description: Owns interstate and intrastate gas pipelines and storage.
segments.evidence: Our Operations and Business Segments DT Midstream sets strategic goals, allocates resources, and evaluates performance based on the following two segments: Pipeline and Gathering.

segments.name: Gathering
segments.description: Gathers natural gas for producers and other customers.
segments.evidence: We provide multiple, integrated natural gas services to customers through our Pipeline segment, which includes interstate pipelines, intrastate pipelines, storage systems, and gathering lateral pipelines, and through our Gathering segment.
